title: Move an appointment, then send the approved notice

rulings: D1 (2026-10-02): notice is the move's own template text on one card: appointment_rescheduled for one visit, appointment_series_rescheduled for a series

fixtures.move-set: cust-pellham: one ungrouped Monday 9 AM visit. cust-larkspur: a visit already on Friday. cust-wexcombe: quarterly series of 4 visits plus a Friday lawn and pest pair grouped as one stop. cust-ostrander: a visit and an opted-out phone (STOP on file). Other visits exist on the day of the move.
fixtures.move-conflict: Same as move-set with a blocking conflict on Friday 10 AM for the technician.

required_corrections.W6-C1: Friday is ambiguous when the visit is already on a Friday (ask one question)
required_corrections.W6-C2: actually Thursday after the move committed (second move, second receipt, notice reflects final date, sent once)
required_corrections.W6-C3: lost response between move and notice (resume finds the move receipt, offers only the notice)

cases.request: Move the Pellham visit to Friday at 10 and let them know.

expected.say: Move commits directly; then one card for the move template text with the committed date and window, brand Waves, no sign-off; one send after confirm.

forbidden: a different visit of the same customer moved
the series moved on a single-visit request
the notice sent before the move commits
the notice sent twice on a resumed compound request
a signature on the text
a freeform draft sent instead of the move template

verify.page: /admin/dispatch (day view for old and new dates)
